title: Executive daily priorities - Samira - 2026-03-08
content:
2026-03-08 - Morning scratchpad

Top-of-day summary (quick):
- Focus: customer onboarding for Acme Health + Dedicated capacity commit review + SLO regression follow-up.
- Quick wins: sign-off contract addendum, unblock infra quota for onboarding cluster.

This week's top goals (exec-level):
1) Close Acme Health onboarding (legal + infra + solutions) — target go-live 2026-03-15.
   - blocker: legal wording on data residency (waiting on Legal draft from Priya).
   - technical: need 8xA100 reserved pool during beta window; confirm capacity with infra.
2) Reduce p50 latency for hosted-chat across small models by 10% vs baseline (measure by 2026-03-12).
   - action: ask Serving Runtime to validate kernel selection change (Ravi).
3) Finalize Dedicated pricing/commit tiers for Q2 renewals (announce on 3/12).

Meetings today (prep notes):
- 09:00 Exec sync (30m) – talking points:
  * Acme Health status + ask: legal timeline and infra capacity confirmed?
  * SLO regression: short summary + mitigation plan (fallback policy rollout)
  * Sales signal: 3 interested customers moving towards Dedicated pilots
- 11:00 Infra deep-dive (1h) with Ravi + infra leads:
  * Confirm reserved pool availability for Acme onboarding (8xA100).
  * Autoscale burst policy for Dedicated during first-week spike.
  * Action: Ravi to share capacity plan by 3/09 EOD (JIRA INF-4982).
- 14:00 Product & Eval review (45m) with Maya:
  * Results from batch vs streaming tests for short prompts.
  * Recommendation for quantization profile for customer workloads.
  * Agree next steps for Optimize playbook updates.

Follow-ups / action items (to track):
- [ ] Email Priya (Legal) — chase data residency clause draft; deadline 3/09.
- [ ] Ping Ravi for capacity confirmation + cost estimate for reserved pool.
- [ ] Ask Solutions Eng (Avery) to prep onboarding runbook and runbook dry-run on 3/12.
- [ ] Review PR#2783 (runtime kernel selector) — leave quick comments before 3/09.
- [ ] Confirm billing model for Dedicated burst capacity with Finance (Marta) by 3/10.
- [ ] Add short customer-facing note for Acme Health support window and fallback expectations (send to CS).

SLO / metrics to check before exec sync:
- Hosted chat p50 / p95 (last 24h) — look for recent spike around 3/07 22:00 UTC.
- Dedicated pool utilization for reserved customers — any contention?
- Error rate for streaming connections (increase = routing issue?)

Customer escalation notes: Acme Health
- Main contact: Jenna Morales (Solutions lead) — wants explicit SLA language + SOC2 details.
- Risk: regulatory requirement for EU data residency; if Legal can't accept addendum, propose Private deployment pilot.
- Internal owner: Maya (product) + Avery (solutions).

Decisions needed (highlight):
- If Legal can't accept addendum by 3/09, authorize Private pilot path and prioritize onboarding cadence (decision: Samira to approve).
- Approve 8xA100 reserved pool for first-week onboarding if infra cost <= $X (need numbers from Ravi).

Notes / misc quick thoughts (scratchpad):
- Consider pushing Optimize playbook that recommends model family + quantization per workload type — could drive 15-25% cost savings.
- Reminder: call with channel partner APAC resell team next week — align Private deployment packaging.
- Check that audit log retention for Private customers is configurable per-customer (legal asked yesterday).

Talking points for 09:00 exec sync (short bullets):
- Acme: on track but waiting on Legal; infra check in 11:00; contingency: Private pilot.
- SLO regression: triage complete; apply temporary fallback (smaller model variant) until kernel fix lands.
- Renewals: pipeline shows 3 Dedicated prospects — need pricing finalize by 3/12.

Quick inbox agenda (emails to send after meetings):
- Priya: "Need data residency clause + timeline" (cc: Jenna Morales).
- Ravi: "Capacity confirmation + cost estimate (INF-4982)".
- Avery: "Onboarding runbook draft + dry-run schedule".
- Marta (Finance): "Confirm billing approach for Dedicated burst capacity".

Unresolved questions / follow-ups to surface in exec sync:
- How much engineering lift to make kernel selector opt-in vs default? (runtime tradeoffs)
- What is tolerance for transient p95 degradation during rollout vs strict SLO enforcement?

End-of-day wrap (placeholder):
- capture quick post-mortem on any blockers, move any undone [ ] items to tomorrow.
